他的演說一開頭就連珠砲似地猛烈批評。
"Howdy, neighbor!" he called from the porch.
「嗨，鄰居！」他在門廊喊道。
The cowboy tipped his hat and said howdy.
牛仔舉了舉帽子說：「嗨。」
The team gave a lacklustre performance in the final.
球隊在決賽中表現乏善可陳。
Sales were lacklustre throughout the winter.
整個冬天銷售都很低迷。
His hands were cold and clammy with fear.
他的雙手因恐懼而冰冷黏濕。
The air in the basement felt clammy.
地下室的空氣感覺又濕又冷。
The price rose only fractionally this month.
這個月價格只微微上漲。
She moved her chair fractionally to the left.
她把椅子往左挪了一點點。
The police made a forcible entry into the building.
警方強行進入那棟建築物。
There was no sign of forcible removal of the lock.
沒有鎖被強行破壞的跡象。
He was known as a rich playboy who loved fast cars.
他以愛開跑車的富有花花公子聞名。
The movie's hero starts out as a lazy playboy.
這部電影的主角一開始是個懶散的花花公子。
He worked at a sawmill by the river.
他在河邊的鋸木廠工作。
The sawmill cuts logs into boards.
鋸木廠把原木鋸成木板。
After the long hike we were ravenous.
長途健行後，我們餓壞了。
The ravenous dog finished its food in seconds.
那隻餓極了的狗幾秒鐘就吃完了食物。
She dropped her keys on the floor.
她把鑰匙掉到地上。
The temperature dropped sharply overnight.
氣溫在一夜之間驟降。

dropped.zh: 放棄；中途退出（drop 的過去式）
ai: He dropped the class after the first week.
他上了第一週就退掉那門課。
The police dropped the case for lack of evidence.
警方因證據不足而撤銷了此案。
The villain had a diabolical plan to take over the town.
那個反派有個邪惡的計畫要接管小鎮。
He gave a diabolical laugh and closed the book.
他發出惡魔般的笑聲，把書闔上。
The weather this weekend was diabolical.
這個週末的天氣糟透了。
The service at that restaurant was absolutely diabolical.
那家餐廳的服務簡直糟透了。
Squats make your quadriceps stronger.
深蹲能讓你的股四頭肌更強壯。
He pulled a quadriceps muscle while sprinting.
他在衝刺時拉傷了股四頭肌。
Everyone despised him for lying to his friends.
大家都因為他欺騙朋友而瞧不起他。
She despised her old job and quit last year.
她很討厭以前的工作，去年就辭職了。
She took up archery and hits the target almost every time.
她開始學射箭，幾乎每次都能射中靶。
Archery requires patience and a steady hand.
射箭需要耐心和穩定的手。
The beaming bride waved to the guests.
笑容滿面的新娘向賓客揮手。
He came home with a beaming smile after the good news.
聽到好消息後，他笑容滿面地回到家。
He looked glum after losing the game.
輸掉比賽後，他看起來悶悶不樂。
The glum faces in the room showed how bad the news was.
房間裡一張張沉重的臉顯示這個消息有多糟。
The shop prices its goods competitively.
這家店的商品定價很有競爭力。
The two brothers play chess competitively.
這對兄弟下棋時互相較勁。
The animator spent months drawing the cartoon character.
動畫師花了好幾個月繪製那個卡通角色。
She dreams of becoming an animator at a film studio.
她夢想成為電影公司的動畫師。
The new medicine proved efficacious against the infection.
這種新藥對感染證實有效。
Regular practice is an efficacious way to learn a language.
規律練習是學語言的有效方法。
Visitors gathered in the rotunda beneath the dome.
遊客聚集在圓頂下的圓形大廳。
The museum's rotunda is used for large events.
博物館的圓形大廳用來舉辦大型活動。

tithe.zh: 什一稅；十分之一的捐獻
ai: Farmers once paid a tithe to the church.
農民過去要向教會繳納什一稅。
She gave a tithe of her income every month.
她每個月捐出收入的十分之一。

tithe.zh: 課什一稅；捐出十分之一收入
ai: Many members tithe regularly to their church.
許多成員定期向教會奉獻十分之一的收入。
He tithes a part of his salary each year.
他每年把部分薪水奉獻出去。
Cables interconnect the computers in the office.
纜線把辦公室裡的電腦互相連接起來。
The new roads interconnect the small towns.
新道路把這些小鎮彼此連結起來。
Nuclear fission produces a large amount of energy.
核分裂會產生大量能量。
Cells reproduce by fission in some simple organisms.
在某些簡單生物中，細胞以分裂方式繁殖。
Guests customarily remove their shoes at the door.
客人通常會在門口脫鞋。
She customarily wakes up before sunrise.
她習慣在日出前起床。

她在一家大醫院的小兒科工作。

他因為喜歡和孩子相處而選擇了小兒科。

孩子轉動萬花筒，看著色彩變化。
The festival was a kaleidoscope of sounds and colors.
這場節慶是聲音與色彩交織的萬花筒。
She spoke to him with obvious condescension.
她用明顯高高在上的態度跟他說話。
I hate the condescension in his voice.
我討厭他聲音中那種居高臨下的口氣。
The haughty manager rarely greeted anyone.
那位傲慢的經理很少跟人打招呼。
She gave him a haughty look and walked away.
她傲慢地看了他一眼就走開了。
The bishop spoke about ecclesial unity.
主教談到了教會的團結。
The document was approved by ecclesial authorities.
這份文件獲得教會當局的核准。
This breathable fabric keeps you cool while running.
這種透氣的布料讓你跑步時保持涼爽。
Choose breathable shoes for the summer.
夏天要選透氣的鞋子。
The air on that planet is not breathable.
那顆行星上的空氣無法呼吸。
Fire fighters checked whether the air was breathable.
消防員檢查空氣是否適合呼吸。
The film was full of vulgarity, so we left early.
這部電影充滿粗俗的內容，所以我們提早離開。
Her manners were free of any vulgarity.
她的舉止毫無粗鄙之處。
The repairman fixed our washing machine in an hour.
修理工一小時就修好了我們的洗衣機。
We called a repairman when the heater stopped working.
暖氣壞掉時，我們叫了修理工來。
He wore a white undershirt beneath his dress shirt.
他在襯衫底下穿了一件白色汗衫。
I bought a pack of cotton undershirts for the winter.
我買了一包純棉汗衫準備過冬。

unstructured.zh: 無固定結構的；非結構化的
ai: The meeting was unstructured, so it wandered from topic to topic.
這場會議沒有固定結構，話題東扯西扯。
The company stores a lot of unstructured data like emails.
公司儲存了許多像電子郵件這類非結構化的資料。
The boy's parentage was a mystery to everyone.
沒有人知道那個男孩的出身。
She is proud of her mixed parentage.
她為自己混合的血統感到驕傲。

mestizo.zh: 梅斯蒂索人（歐洲與拉丁美洲原住民混血的人）
ai: Many people in Mexico are mestizo.
墨西哥有許多人是梅斯蒂索人。
The book describes the history of the mestizo population.
這本書介紹了梅斯蒂索人口的歷史。
The fox slyly watched the chickens.
狐狸狡黠地盯著那些雞。
He slyly winked at his sister across the table.
他隔著桌子偷偷對妹妹眨眼。
The police kept a thick dossier on the case.
警方保存了一份厚厚的案件卷宗。

她為每位求職者準備了一份檔案。

這場討論讓我對未來的計畫更明確。

開完長會後，他的想法開始成形。
Sugar will crystallise as the syrup cools.
糖漿冷卻時，糖會結晶。
Salt crystallises when the seawater dries.
海水乾掉時，鹽會結晶。

and 和 but 是英文中常見的連接詞。
Use a connective to link the two sentences.
用一個連接詞把這兩個句子連起來。
Connective tissue holds the body's parts together.
結締組織把身體的各部分連在一起。
The writer added connective phrases to improve the flow.
作者加了一些連接用語讓文章更流暢。
There is a vending machine near the school gate.
學校大門附近有一台自動販賣機。
The vending business grew quickly in the city.
這座城市的自動販賣事業成長得很快。

facing.zh: 面對；面向（face 的現在分詞）
ai: The house is facing the sea.
這棟房子面向大海。
She is facing a hard choice this week.
她這週正面臨一個艱難的抉擇。
The facing on the collar is made of silk.
領口的貼邊是絲質的。
The stone facing of the building protects the walls.
這棟建築的石材飾面保護著牆壁。
Children learn to read through phonics in the first grade.
孩子們在一年級透過自然發音法學習閱讀。
The teacher uses phonics to explain how letters sound.
老師用自然發音法解釋字母怎麼發音。
Havana is the capital of Cuba.
哈瓦那是古巴的首都。
Havana lies on the northern coast of Cuba.
哈瓦那位於古巴的北岸。
The frog begins life in a larval stage as a tadpole.
青蛙一開始是幼蟲階段的蝌蚪。

科學家研究了這種甲蟲的幼蟲形態。
She finished the test with a modicum of effort.
她只花了一點點力氣就寫完考卷。
Every team needs a modicum of trust to work well.
每個團隊都需要一點基本的信任才能運作良好。
The two studies reached convergent results.
這兩項研究得出趨於一致的結果。
The lines on the map are convergent near the city.
地圖上的這些線在城市附近交會。
I peeled a tangerine and shared it with my sister.
我剝了一顆橘子和姊姊分著吃。
The tangerine juice tastes sweet and fresh.
這杯橘子汁嚐起來又甜又新鮮。
The project sank into a morass of delays.
這個專案陷入一片延誤的泥淖。
We tried to find our way through the morass of rules.
我們試著在一大堆複雜的規定中找出方向。
The hikers crossed a muddy morass with care.
登山客小心地穿越一片泥濘的沼澤。
Frogs lived in the morass beside the road.
青蛙住在路旁的沼澤裡。
Don't squish the bread when you pack the bag.
裝袋子時別把麵包壓扁了。
My wet shoes squished with every step.
我的濕鞋子每走一步就發出咯吱聲。
The menu was a hodgepodge of different cuisines.
這份菜單是各國料理的大雜燴。
Her room was a hodgepodge of books, clothes, and toys.
她的房間堆滿書、衣服和玩具，雜亂無章。
The children were uninhibited and danced everywhere.
孩子們毫無拘束，到處跳舞。
She gave an uninhibited laugh at the joke.
她對那個笑話毫不拘束地大笑。
The country announced retaliatory measures against the ban.
該國宣布對禁令採取報復性措施。
He feared a retaliatory attack from the other team.
他擔心另一隊的報復性攻擊。

unattached.zh: 單身的；沒有附屬關係的
ai: She is young, smart, and unattached.
她年輕又聰明，還單身。
The old shed stood unattached to the main house.
那間舊棚屋與主屋是分開的。
This job is well suited to someone who loves people.
這份工作很適合喜歡與人相處的人。
He is not suited to working alone all day.
他不適合整天一個人工作。
The minstrel sang about brave knights at the castle.
吟遊詩人在城堡裡唱著勇敢騎士的故事。
A traveling minstrel played the lute in the square.
一位旅行的吟遊詩人在廣場上彈著魯特琴。
He lost his job because of her machinations.
他因為她的陰謀而丟了工作。
The film is about the machinations of a power-hungry advisor.
這部電影講的是一位權力欲強的顧問的種種陰謀。
The soldiers stood in silent solemnity during the ceremony.
儀式中士兵們肅穆地靜立著。
There was a note of solemnity in her voice.
她的聲音帶著一絲嚴肅。
For him, a weekend with family is sacrosanct.
對他來說，和家人共度週末是神聖不可侵犯的。
The rules of the old club were sacrosanct.
那個老俱樂部的規矩神聖不可更動。
The gang tried to extort money from the shop owners.
那幫人想向店家勒索錢財。
He was caught trying to extort a bribe from a driver.
他因試圖向駕駛人敲詐賄款而被逮捕。
She has long dyed hair, bright red in color.
她留著一頭染成亮紅色的長髮。
The shop sells hand-dyed wool in many colors.
這家店販售多種顏色的手染羊毛。

recant.zh: 公開收回前言；放棄原本的主張
ai: The witness chose to recant his earlier statement.
證人選擇收回先前的證詞。
She refused to recant her beliefs, even under pressure.
即使承受壓力，她也不肯放棄自己的信念。
She prudently saved part of her salary every month.
她每個月謹慎地存下一部分薪水。
He prudently checked the ice before stepping on it.
他踩上冰面之前謹慎地先檢查。
The strong wind upended the garden table.
強風把花園的桌子吹翻了。
The new technology could upend the whole industry.
這項新技術可能顛覆整個產業。
Some groups go door to door to proselytize.
有些團體挨家挨戶去勸人改信。
He does not proselytize, but he enjoys talking about his faith.
他不會強迫別人改信，但喜歡談論自己的信仰。
